system.name: SuperServe
system.one_liner: a fine-grained inference-serving system that activates subnetworks of a shared supernetwork per query to meet unpredictable per-query latency SLOs

components.name: Router
components.role: receives client queries, holds the EDF queue, runs the scheduler, and returns predictions

components.name: EDF Queue
components.role: earliest-deadline-first queue holding queries ordered by absolute deadline D

components.name: Scheduler
components.role: decides the query-batch (B) and subnetwork (star) for the query at the head of the queue

components.name: Dispatcher
components.role: sends the chosen batch and subnetwork to a worker

components.name: Result Queue
components.role: holds worker predictions before returning them to clients

components.name: Supernetwork Profiler
components.role: runs NAS and latency profiling offline to find Pareto-optimal subnetworks per latency target

components.name: Worker1
components.role: instantiates a supernetwork and actuates the dispatched subnetwork in place on its GPU

components.name: Worker2
components.role: instantiates a supernetwork and actuates the dispatched subnetwork in place on its GPU

components.name: Supernetwork
components.role: a single network containing many subnetworks that can be selectively activated on the GPU

flows.what: asynchronous RPC query with an SLO deadline
invocation when a worker becomes available and the EDF queue is non-empty
chosen batch size B and subnetwork
in-place actuation of the chosen subnetwork on the GPU, then inference
predictions redirected back to the client
latency profile used by the scheduler

content.key_idea: SuperServe routes deadline-bound queries through an EDF queue and a scheduler that jointly picks batch size and a Pareto-optimal subnetwork per query, dispatched to GPU workers that actuate only that subnetwork of a shared supernetwork.
content.reading_order: Starts at the client on the left, follows numbered circles through the router's internal EDF queue, scheduler and dispatcher, out to the two workers on the right, and back to the client.

evidence: SuperServe consists of a router, scheduler, workers and a supernetwork profiler.
The client submits asynchronous RPC queries to the router with a deadline.
As soon as any worker becomes available, 's fine-grained scheduler is invoked

summary: SuperServe is a fine-grained inference-serving system for unpredictable workloads that activates a subnetwork of a shared supernetwork per query to meet latency SLOs. The figure shows a central Router containing an EDF queue, scheduler, dispatcher, and result queue, flanked by a client on the left and two GPU workers on the right, each hosting a supernetwork. Numbered circles trace the critical path: the client submits a deadline-bound query, it is enqueued by absolute deadline, the scheduler picks a batch size and subnetwork once a worker is free, the dispatcher sends the batch to a worker, the worker actuates that subnetwork in place on the GPU and runs inference, and predictions flow back through the router to the client. Two color-coded example queries (green and blue) walk through this same pipeline to the two different workers. An inset heatmap of measured latency by batch size and subnetwork, plus a Pareto accuracy-vs-latency scatter plot, explain the offline Supernetwork Profiler that feeds the scheduler's choices.
summary_zh: SuperServe 是面向不可预测负载的细粒度推理服务系统，图示以路由器为中心的架构：EDF 队列、调度器、分发器与结果队列，两侧连接客户端与两个 GPU worker，编号圆圈标出查询从提交到返回预测的关键路径，绿蓝两色示例展示不同查询被调度到不同 worker，并附带离线的超网络画像器与延迟热力图。
